purpose: Make Whit visually legible as the Orb companion that is present, reflects and answers, without changing the approved Home Orb or the governed generation path.

experience.home: Whit remains silent and does not overlay or redesign the approved central Home Orb.
experience.otherWorlds: Existing Whit Presence V307 appears briefly as a small living companion orb with contextual text and then rests.
experience.aiWorld: Whit Mind V312 reads as a companion orb. During the existing ai-streaming state the orb brightens and pulses while the existing response bubble says that the Orb is reflecting.
experience.answer: Existing assistant bubbles remain the canonical generated answer and are visually identified as Whit without changing their content.
experience.audio: No automatic audible speech is introduced in V314. Any future voice layer must be opt-in and use an original synthetic voice, never a real-person voice clone.
